schema_evolution_note: Frozen Day 10 schema — updated only if new features added in Day 11+. Any change must bump schema_version and be noted in the thesis §3.4.3.
description: CST3990 Block C features.csv column schema. F1+F2 defined Day 10. F3 added Day 11.

columns.name: conf
columns.description: Detection confidence. -1.0 = interpolated frame sentinel (Fix F22)

columns.name: is_interpolated
columns.description: True if frame was synthetically inserted by Day 9 post_processor

columns.name: velocity_norm
columns.description: Raw frame-to-frame Euclidean displacement from _final.json (640×640 space)

columns.name: vel_px_sec_smooth
columns.description: Rolling mean of vel_px_sec over speed_window=int(0.2*fps) frames per track

columns.name: vehicle_count
columns.description: F1.1: unique active track_ids per frame

columns.name: roi_occupancy
columns.description: F1.2: vehicle_count / max_vehicle_count per clip. Full-frame ROI proxy (Fix F17)

columns.name: track_length_real
columns.description: Genuine detection count for this track — computed from full pre-strip trajectory entries using interpolated==False (not from file header)

dwell_time_sec.rationale: Cumulative dwell since first post-warm-up appearance. Stronger anomaly signal for Illegal Parking / Stalled Vehicle than instantaneous region-dwell. Instantaneous spatial dwell deferred pending camera calibration (Fix F19).

notes: F3 columns are NOT present in Day 10 CSVs. They are added by Day 11.
Do NOT add placeholder NaN columns for F3 in Day 10 outputs.
is_interpolated=True rows carry conf=-1.0 as sentinel (Fix F22).
All bbox and centroid values are in 640×640 inference space (not original 960×540).
vel_px_sec is an image-space proxy — not calibrated to real-world km/h.
track_length_real counts genuine detections only (interpolated==False); computed from full pre-strip DataFrame — never from the post-warm-up view.
